# v0.1.19 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.19. The capability version is 12.

A job that waited for capacity is checked out again before it is
submitted when the worker uses the poll clone. Before, a later pass
could leave the clone on another commit, so the run tested the wrong
commit and its final status was refused.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
